camel_example: aliyun sas CreateServiceLinkedRole --region cn-hangzhou --ServiceLinkedRole AliyunServiceRoleForSas --DryRun true --ClientToken 'example-string'
description_en: Creates a service-linked role and grants Security Center permissions to access cloud resources
description_zh: 创建服务关联角色并授权云安全中心访问云资源
kebab_example: aliyun sas create-service-linked-role --service-linked-role AliyunServiceRoleForSas --client-token example-string --dry-run true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateServiceLinkedRole

parameters.help_en:
The service-linked role. Default value: AliyunServiceRoleForSas. Valid values:

AliyunServiceRoleForSas: the service-linked role for Security Center. Security Center uses this role to access your resources in other Alibaba Cloud services.
AliyunServiceRoleForSasCspm: the service-linked role for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) of Security Center. CSPM uses this role to access your resources in other Alibaba Cloud services
parameters.help_zh:
关联角色。默认AliyunServiceRoleForSas。取值：

AliyunServiceRoleForSas：用于云安全中心(sas)的服务关联角色，云安全中心(sas)使用此角色来访问您在其他云产品中的资源。
AliyunServiceRoleForSasCspm：用于云安全中心-CSPM(sas-cspm)的服务关联角色，sas-cspm使用此角色来访问您在其他云产品中的资源
parameters.name: service_linked_role

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You must use different tokens for different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端 Token，用于保证请求幂等性。不同请求应使用不同的 Token；只支持 ASCII 字符，长度不超过 64 个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. A value of true indicates that only the request is checked and no actual operations are performed. A value of false indicates that the request is normally executed. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否只预检此次请求。true 表示仅检查请求、不执行实际操作，false 表示正常执行请求，默认值为 false
parameters.name: dry_run

schema.description_en: The response for creating a service-linked role and granting Security Center permissions to access cloud resources
schema.description_zh: 创建服务关联角色并授权云安全中心访问云资源返回结果

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. It is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
